Saturn.trainerWins: Thinking done. A better world includes my win.
Saturn.trainerLoses: Food for thought. I'll think on it.

Charon.greeting: Hohoho! A Team Galactic Commander, and a scientist besides! Let us experiment!
Charon.trainerWins: Hohoho! The experiment confirms my genius!
Charon.trainerLoses: Hohoho... the data must be wrong. Surely.

Charon.greeting: Power is everything, child. Power and knowledge. Do you have either?
These Alolan legends are fascinating. Imagine the power... hohoho!
Charon.trainerLoses: The power slipped away. Hohoho... I'll find more.

N.greeting: I'm N. I want to hear your partners' voices. Will you let them speak through this battle?
N.trainerWins: Their voices are kind, but they're tired. Let them rest.
N.trainerLoses: Your partners are happy with you. I can hear it.

N.greeting: Truth, ideals... I still don't know which is right. Maybe this battle will tell me.
N.trainerWins: This time, the battle didn't give me an answer.
N.trainerLoses: Maybe your way is the answer. I'll think about it.

N.greeting: Alola's people live so closely with their partners. I wanted to see it for myself.
N.trainerWins: Close bonds, but not close enough. Not yet.
N.trainerLoses: Close bonds, and real strength. Thank you.

Ghetsis.greeting: I am Ghetsis. You'll find I don't lose gracefully, so I simply don't lose.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: As I said. I don't lose.

Ghetsis.greeting: Power belongs to those who know how to use it. Let me demonstrate.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: You dare use power against me?!

Ghetsis.greeting: I am merely a humble Sage, here to enjoy the islands... and crush whoever I meet.
Ghetsis.trainerWins: Crushed, as planned. How humble of me.
Ghetsis.trainerLoses: Not as planned. Not at all as planned.

Zinzolin.greeting: I am Zinzolin, one of Team Plasma's Sages. I find the tropics dreadfully hot.
Zinzolin.trainerLoses: Defeat and heat. A terrible combination.

Zinzolin.greeting: Ice is patient. It waits, and then it shatters everything. Shall we wait together?
Zinzolin.trainerWins: The ice shatters. As it always does.

Zinzolin.greeting: Team Plasma had grand plans once. Today, I plan only to win.

Lysandre.greeting: I am Lysandre. I want a beautiful world. Show me whether you belong in it.
Lysandre.trainerWins: You don't belong in it. Yet.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: You belong in it more than I do. How bitter.

Lysandre.greeting: Those who take without giving make the world ugly. Which are you?
Lysandre.trainerWins: You took a chance and gave me a win. Thank you.
Lysandre.trainerLoses: You gave everything. I respect that deeply.

Lysandre.greeting: A café owner, a scientist, a dreamer. Today, simply a challenger.
Lysandre.trainerWins: Simply a challenger, and simply a winner.

Xerosic.greeting: Hmhmhm... Xerosic, Team Flare's finest scientist. You'll make a fine test subject!
Xerosic.trainerWins: Data collected! Thank you, test subject!
Xerosic.trainerLoses: Hmm?! The data... contradicts my hypothesis!

Xerosic.greeting: Science has no morals. Only results. Let's get some results!
I built many gadgets in my time. None as satisfying as a good battle.
Xerosic.trainerLoses: Back to the lab, I suppose.

Bryony.greeting: I'm Bryony, a Team Flare admin. Let's make this quick; I have a fitting later.
Bryony.trainerWins: Quick, as promised. Off to my fitting.
Bryony.trainerLoses: I'll be late for my fitting now. Thanks a lot.

Bryony.greeting: Elegance is a weapon. Most people don't know how to wield it.
Alola's fashion is so... casual. I'll bring a little class to this battle.
Bryony.trainerLoses: Even class can't save every look.

Mable.greeting: I'm Mable, Team Flare admin. Blue suits me, and so does winning.
Research is my specialty. Let's research your weaknesses.
Mable.trainerLoses: Research says I'm the weak one. How annoying.

Mable.greeting: Team Flare is gone, but my ambition isn't. Let's see yours.
Mable.trainerLoses: Your ambition is bigger. For now.

Lusamine.greeting: I love all Pokémon, truly. That's why I'll show you how beautiful they are when they win.
Lusamine.trainerWins: Beautiful, weren't they? I love them so.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: You made my beauties lose? How cruel of you.

Lusamine.greeting: As President of the Aether Foundation, I protect what I love. Don't make me protect it from you.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: You've hurt what I love. I'll remember this.

Lusamine.greeting: My children say I'm too much. I say there's no such thing as too much love.
Lusamine.trainerLoses: Even love isn't enough sometimes. How painful.

Faba.greeting: I, Faba, Branch Chief of the Aether Foundation, will grace you with a battle. Be grateful.
Faba.trainerWins: You should be grateful. That was a privilege.
Faba.trainerLoses: This is... a temporary setback for a genius like me!

Faba.greeting: My research will change the world. A battle with you will barely change my afternoon.
Faba.trainerWins: As predicted. My afternoon remains unchanged.

Faba.greeting: Do you know how important I am? Very. Let me show you.
Faba.trainerLoses: Important people lose sometimes too... rarely.

Izzy.greeting: One moment I was at my laptop, the next I was here. I've been researching this world ever since. Prodigious!
Izzy.trainerWins: Just as my calculations predicted! I'll add this battle to my research notes.
Izzy.trainerLoses: Fascinating... I clearly overlooked a few variables. Back to the data!

Izzy.greeting: My partner was reformatted the moment we crossed over. Same heart, all-new data. Let me show you what we learned!
Izzy.trainerWins: Knowledge is power, and today's data proves it!
Izzy.trainerLoses: Your strategy didn't fit any of my models. I'll have to revise my theory.

Izzy.greeting: Tai and the others were pulled into this world too. They explore it; I study it. Care to be my next data point?
Izzy.trainerWins: Wait till I tell Tai! He never believes my theories until he sees them work.
Izzy.trainerLoses: Tai would say I overthought it. Please don't tell him he was right.

Tate.greeting: Hehehe! Did you think you'd face us one at a time?
We can feel each other's thoughts...

Liza.greeting: Our teamwork is out of this world!

Tai.greeting: Me and Matt, together again! Courage and Friendship, just like old times on File Island!
Tai.trainerWins: See, Matt? Charging in works! ...With you covering me, anyway.
Tai.trainerLoses: Okay, that one's on me. Matt, don't say it.

Tai.greeting: Our partners fought side by side to save two worlds. One tree's nothing! Right, Matt?
Tai.trainerWins: Two worlds, one tree! Fist bump, Matt!
Tai.trainerLoses: We've lost before and come back stronger. Right, Matt?

Tai.greeting: Matt and I fought each other plenty as kids. Fighting alongside him is way better. Ready?
Tai.trainerWins: Best rivals, best friends, best team! That's us!
Tai.trainerLoses: Ugh! We'll get 'em in the rematch. I'll lead this time... again.

Matt.greeting: Try not to run ahead this time, Tai. ...Fine. Let's show them what the DigiDestined can do.
Matt.trainerWins: You ran ahead. Again. Good thing I was there. ...Nice job, Tai.
Matt.trainerLoses: I wasn't going to say anything, Tai. ...Your plan was terrible, though.

Matt.greeting: Two worlds, and he still forgets to plan. Stay sharp, Tai. These two are good.
Matt.trainerWins: ...Fine. One fist bump. Don't make it weird, Tai.
Matt.trainerLoses: Right. And next time, we follow my plan.

Matt.greeting: Tai's the sun, I'm the moon. Annoying, but it works. Let's go.
Matt.trainerWins: Don't let it go to your head, Tai. ...It was a good win.
Matt.trainerLoses: You always lead, Tai. Maybe that's the problem. ...Kidding. Mostly.

multiNote: Lines for trainers who always battle together as opponents in a Multi Battle (Tate and Liza; Tai and Matt): the same set index is used for both, so they answer each other. Used only when they battle together.
pairsNote: Greetings for two special trainers drawn together in a Multi Battle who share a region or a type (written for this app). Each entry has one greeting per trainer; their closing remarks are their usual ones. To add a pair, add an entry with both trainers' names and a greeting for each. The Elite Four and Champions (added 2026-10-10) also greet partners they have a relationship with (Koga and Janine, Lance and Clair, Wallace and Juan, Flint and Volkner, Iris and Drayden...), other Champions, and a few kindred spirits (Siebold with the Striaton chefs and Mallow, Diantha with Brycen, Kukui with Crasher Wake). The evil teams' leaders and admins (added 2026-10-11) follow the region rule too, plus Giovanni with his Rocket Executives; trainers with two versions (Archie, Maxie) are listed by their key ("Archie (ORAS)") and never paired with themselves.

Brock & Misty.Brock: Misty and I go way back. Pewter and Cerulean, rock and water. We know each other's moves by heart.
Brock & Misty.Misty: Brock, if you start flirting with the Pokémon Center nurse mid-battle, I'm soaking you myself!

Brock & Lt. Surge.Brock: Surge says his Electric types will carry us. My Rock types say they'll be the ones standing at the end.
Brock & Lt. Surge.Lt. Surge: Hey, kid! Pewter's rock wall and Vermilion's lightning, together. Your team won't know what hit it!

Brock & Erika.Brock: Erika keeps watering the plants by the stairs. Rock and Grass get along better than you'd think.
Brock & Erika.Erika: Brock offered to carry my flower arrangements up the tree. Such a sturdy gentleman. Now, shall we?

Brock & Janine.Brock: Janine was standing behind me this whole time? Kanto's ninja is good. I'll handle the front line.
Brock & Janine.Janine: Brock never even noticed me. Kanto's rock is strong, but my poison strikes from the shadows!

Brock & Sabrina.Brock: Sabrina says she already knows how this ends. As a Kanto Leader, I prefer to earn it the hard way.
Brock & Sabrina.Sabrina: Brock's defense and my foresight. I have seen this battle, and Kanto does not lose it.

Brock & Blaine.Brock: Blaine asked me a quiz question on the way up. I got it wrong. Let's hope my battling goes better.
Brock & Blaine.Blaine: Hah! Brock's rocks don't melt, but my fire will melt your hopes! Kanto's quiz is in session!

Brock & Giovanni.Brock: I'm teaming up with Giovanni? Viridian's Gym Leader... and Team Rocket's boss. Just this once.
Brock & Giovanni.Giovanni: The Pewter Gym Leader. Reliable, like the bedrock under Viridian. He'll do as a shield.

Misty & Lt. Surge.Misty: Surge, if your Electric attack hits my Water Pokémon, you're buying the whole team dinner!
Misty & Lt. Surge.Lt. Surge: Ha! Misty's afraid I'll zap her team. Don't worry, kid, I only aim at the enemy. Mostly!

Misty & Erika.Misty: Erika's Grass types and my Water types? Cerulean and Celadon's cutest combo. Let's go!
Misty & Erika.Erika: Misty keeps my garden watered and my battles lively. Kanto's flowers bloom brightest together.

Misty & Janine.Misty: Janine snuck up on me in the lobby! I almost threw a Water Gun at her. We're on the same team, right?
Misty & Janine.Janine: Misty's temper is louder than a thunderstorm. Good. It keeps you looking at her while I strike.

Misty & Sabrina.Misty: Sabrina gives me the chills, but she's on my side today. Saffron and Cerulean. Bring it!
Misty & Sabrina.Sabrina: Misty's fire burns hotter than her Water types. I foresee her splashing you out of this battle.

Misty & Blaine.Misty: Blaine's fire and my water. We'll make so much steam you won't see a thing!
Misty & Blaine.Blaine: Hah! Water and fire, side by side! Even my hot springs can't match Misty's temper!

Misty & Giovanni.Misty: Giovanni? You'd better not try anything funny. I'll be watching you, Team Rocket!
Misty & Giovanni.Giovanni: The Cerulean Gym Leader has a fiery spirit. Aim it at our opponent, and we'll get along.

Lt. Surge & Erika.Lt. Surge: Erika, take a nap if you want. I'll electrify 'em before you wake up! Kanto's strongest, coming through!
Lt. Surge & Erika.Erika: Lt. Surge is so loud. Still, Vermilion and Celadon make quite the bouquet. Let's battle.

Lt. Surge & Janine.Lt. Surge: Janine's a sneaky little ninja. Me? I come in loud, like a thunderclap. Kanto covers both!
Lt. Surge & Janine.Janine: The Lieutenant made so much noise climbing up, they'll never notice me slipping in.

Lt. Surge & Sabrina.Lt. Surge: Saffron's right next door to Vermilion. Sabrina predicts, I electrocute. Easy mission, soldier!
Lt. Surge & Sabrina.Sabrina: Surge's lightning is predictable. That is why it works so well with my power. Kanto will win.

Lt. Surge & Blaine.Lt. Surge: Blaine, old man! You burn 'em, I zap 'em! What's left is a pile of ashes and sparks!
Lt. Surge & Blaine.Blaine: Hah! Surge's sparks and my blaze! Quiz time: what's left of your team after this? Nothing!

Lt. Surge & Giovanni.Lt. Surge: Giovanni and I go way back. Two Kanto Leaders who don't mess around. Prepare yourself, kid!
Lt. Surge & Giovanni.Giovanni: Lt. Surge follows orders well. Today, my orders are simple: crush this challenger.

Erika & Janine.Erika: Janine wanted to borrow some of my Grass Pokémon's sleep powder. I believe she has a plan.
Erika & Janine.Janine: Erika's flowers smell lovely. Mine smell lovely too... right before the poison sets in.

Erika & Sabrina.Erika: Sabrina says she foresaw me falling asleep. How rude. I was merely resting my eyes. Shall we?
Erika & Sabrina.Sabrina: Erika's garden is calm. My mind is calm. Your defeat will be quite peaceful.

Erika & Blaine.Erika: Blaine, please mind my flowers with your fire. Kanto's Leaders must work together, after all.
Erika & Blaine.Blaine: Hah! Erika's worried about her flowers. Don't fret! I only burn challengers. Quiz time!

Erika & Giovanni.Erika: Giovanni... I remember Team Rocket's Game Corner in Celadon. Very well. Just for today.
Erika & Giovanni.Giovanni: Celadon's Gym Leader. Elegant, and far tougher than she looks. Let's see what she can do.

Janine & Sabrina.Janine: Sabrina read my mind before I could sneak up on her. Fine. Then you'll be the one surprised!
Janine & Sabrina.Sabrina: Janine moves without a sound. I move without moving. Kanto's quiet Leaders are its deadliest.

Janine & Blaine.Janine: Blaine's quizzes are so loud! Okay, Blaine, here's mine: where am I hiding? Exactly. Let's go!
Janine & Blaine.Blaine: Hah! Janine's poison and my fire. Here's a quiz: how fast can a challenger fall? Very!

Janine & Giovanni.Janine: Father worked for Giovanni once. I'll show him what Koga's daughter can do on her own!
Janine & Giovanni.Giovanni: Koga's daughter. Her father served me well. Let's see if she has his talent.

Sabrina & Blaine.Sabrina: Blaine's next quiz question: how will this battle end? I already know the answer.
Sabrina & Blaine.Blaine: Hah! Sabrina knows all my quiz answers. No fair! Still, a psychic partner's a fine thing to have!

Sabrina & Giovanni.Sabrina: Team Rocket once took over Saffron's Silph Co. I foresaw today's alliance. I didn't like it.
Sabrina & Giovanni.Giovanni: The Saffron Gym Leader. Her power is genuine. Together, Kanto's might is beyond your reach.

Blaine & Giovanni.Blaine: Hah! Giovanni! I quit working for Team Rocket's lab years ago! Today, we're just Kanto Leaders!
Blaine & Giovanni.Giovanni: Blaine. Hot-tempered, but brilliant. Viridian and Cinnabar will scorch this challenger to the ground.

Falkner & Bugsy.Falkner: Bugsy loves Bug types. I love Flying types. Johto's first two Gyms will show you the way up!
Falkner & Bugsy.Bugsy: Falkner's Flying types eat Bug types in the wild... but in battle, we're the best of friends!

Falkner & Whitney.Falkner: Whitney's team is fearsome when she's not crying. My father taught me to soar above any trouble. Johto takes flight!
Falkner & Whitney.Whitney: Falkner's birds are so cute! Teaming up with them is gonna be super fun. No crying today!

Falkner & Morty.Falkner: Morty's ghosts and my birds both rule the Johto skies. We'll show you the mystic heights!
Falkner & Morty.Morty: Falkner's wings over Violet City, my visions over Ecruteak. Johto's skies favor us today.

Falkner & Chuck.Falkner: Chuck's been doing pushups since we got here. I'll keep the skies clear while he punches!
Falkner & Chuck.Chuck: Falkner, your birds are tough! But can they lift boulders? Wahahah! Johto's strength, together!

Falkner & Jasmine.Falkner: Jasmine's Steel types can take my Flying types' hits... so it's a good thing we're partners.
Falkner & Jasmine.Jasmine: Falkner's birds flew me from Olivine. The view from the lighthouse is nothing like this tree.

Falkner & Pryce.Falkner: Pryce has trained longer than I've been alive. Johto's youngest and oldest Leaders, side by side.
Falkner & Pryce.Pryce: Young Falkner flies so freely. I remember those days. Let's show this challenger winter's chill.

Falkner & Clair.Falkner: Clair's dragons fly higher than my birds. Don't tell her I said that. Johto, take wing!
Falkner & Clair.Clair: Falkner's birds are adequate. My dragons rule the skies. Johto's skies, that is. Let's go.

Bugsy & Whitney.Bugsy: Whitney cried when I showed her my bug collection. But today, she's going to make you cry instead!
Bugsy & Whitney.Whitney: Bugsy's bugs gave me a fright, but they're tough! Our Johto team-up is gonna be the best!

Bugsy & Morty.Bugsy: Morty says there are ghost bugs in Ecruteak's Burned Tower. I need to research that! After this!
Bugsy & Morty.Morty: Bugsy researches everything. I research the unseen. Between us, Johto knows your every move.

Bugsy & Chuck.Bugsy: Chuck says bugs are too small to be strong. Just watch my team, Chuck! Johto power!
Bugsy & Chuck.Chuck: Bugsy's bugs are tougher than they look! Like a waterfall's spray. Wahahah! Let's go!

Bugsy & Jasmine.Bugsy: Jasmine's Steel types are hard to research. They're so shiny! Let's study this battle together!
Bugsy & Jasmine.Jasmine: Bugsy told me all about Bug types on the way up. I... learned a lot. Let's do our best.

Bugsy & Pryce.Bugsy: Pryce says bugs don't survive Mahogany's winters. Mine do! I bred them myself!
Bugsy & Pryce.Pryce: Bugsy's enthusiasm reminds me of my youth. Johto's oldest and youngest. Let's show you what we know.

Bugsy & Clair.Bugsy: Clair says dragons outclass bugs. My research says otherwise! Johto's Gyms, together!
Bugsy & Clair.Clair: A bug researcher as my partner? Fine. Just stay out of my dragons' way, Bugsy.

Whitney & Morty.Whitney: Morty's ghosts are spooky! But with them on my side, nothing can scare me. Johto's cutest Leader is here!
Whitney & Morty.Morty: Whitney cried at the Burned Tower. Today, I foresee her laughing. Ecruteak and Goldenrod, together.

Whitney & Chuck.Whitney: Chuck's all muscles and I'm all heart! Goldenrod and Cianwood, let's roll right over 'em!
Whitney & Chuck.Chuck: Whitney's team rolls in like a boulder down a waterfall! Wahahah! We're unbeatable!

Whitney & Jasmine.Whitney: Jasmine and I go shopping in Goldenrod sometimes! Today, we're shopping for a win!
Whitney & Jasmine.Jasmine: Whitney is my friend. She's very... energetic. I'll do my best to keep up. Let's battle.

Whitney & Pryce.Whitney: Pryce is like a grumpy grandpa. But he's super strong! Johto's not losing today!
Whitney & Pryce.Pryce: Whitney's tears could freeze in Mahogany's cold. Let's make sure she has nothing to cry about.

Whitney & Clair.Whitney: Clair's so cool and scary! I bet her dragons and my cuties make the strongest Johto team ever!
Whitney & Clair.Clair: Whitney's team is the one thing in Goldenrod I respect. Don't slow me down.

Morty & Chuck.Morty: Chuck punches what he can see. My ghosts strike what you can't. Johto has you surrounded.
Morty & Chuck.Chuck: Morty's ghosts give me goosebumps! But Fighting moves don't touch them... so they're perfect partners!

Morty & Jasmine.Morty: Jasmine's Steel types stand firm against my ghosts. Today, they stand beside them. Shall we?
Morty & Jasmine.Jasmine: Morty told me Ecruteak's legends about a rainbow-winged guardian. I hope I see it over the Olivine lighthouse someday.

Morty & Pryce.Morty: Pryce has seen many winters, and I have seen many spirits. Johto's wisdom is on our side.
Morty & Pryce.Pryce: Morty, the Ecruteak mystic. Young, but he sees deeply. Together, we'll see this through.

Morty & Clair.Morty: Clair's dragons are legendary in Blackthorn. In Ecruteak, we have our own legends. Let's battle.
Morty & Clair.Clair: Morty's still waiting for his rainbow legend, isn't he? Fine. I'll show you a real legend: my dragons.

Chuck & Jasmine.Chuck: Jasmine's from Olivine, just across the sea from Cianwood! I'll swim over to help any time!
Chuck & Jasmine.Jasmine: Chuck is very loud. But strong. Cianwood and Olivine's Gym Leaders will make a sturdy team.

Chuck & Pryce.Chuck: Pryce trains under ice! I train under waterfalls! Johto's toughest training, combined!
Chuck & Pryce.Pryce: Chuck's waterfall training is impressive. Try it in Mahogany's winter, young man.

Chuck & Clair.Chuck: Clair, your dragons are strong! But can they do a hundred pushups? Mine can! Johto power!
Chuck & Clair.Clair: Chuck's fists won't scratch my dragons. Good thing they're aimed at you today.

Jasmine & Pryce.Jasmine: Pryce is very wise. He told me Steel types can stand any winter. I'll trust him.
Jasmine & Pryce.Pryce: Jasmine is gentle, but her Steel types never bend. Johto's strongest, together.

Jasmine & Clair.Jasmine: Clair... looks scary. But her dragons protected me on the way up. Let's battle together.
Jasmine & Clair.Clair: Jasmine's Steel types can take a dragon's hit. Useful. Stay behind me, Olivine.

Pryce & Clair.Pryce: Clair. Your dragons once fell to my ice. Today, they'll rise beside it. Johto stands strong.
Pryce & Clair.Clair: Pryce's ice is the only thing I've ever feared. Today, it's your problem. Let's go.

Roxanne & Brawly.Roxanne: Brawly surfs, I study. Rustboro and Dewford are neighbors by boat, and our strategies fit together.
Roxanne & Brawly.Brawly: Roxanne's got the notes, I've got the waves! Hoenn's first two Gyms are gonna wipe you out!

Roxanne & Wattson.Roxanne: Wattson laughs through every battle. I took notes on why it works. Hoenn's lesson starts now.
Roxanne & Wattson.Wattson: Wahahahah! Roxanne's the smartest Leader in Hoenn, and I'm the most electrifying! Ready?

Roxanne & Flannery.Roxanne: Flannery's fire meets my Rock types' defense. According to my notes, that's an excellent pairing.
Roxanne & Flannery.Flannery: Roxanne's so put together! I'm trying to be, too. Lavaridge and Rustboro, let's heat things up!

Roxanne & Norman.Roxanne: Norman is the most respected Leader in Hoenn. I studied his battles at the Trainers' School.
Roxanne & Norman.Norman: Roxanne taught at the Trainers' School. Her students learn well. Let's give you a lesson, too.

Roxanne & Winona.Roxanne: Winona's Flying types cover the sky; my Rock types hold the ground. Hoenn has you surrounded.
Roxanne & Winona.Winona: Roxanne's Rock types are sturdy, like Fortree's treetops. Let's soar to victory.

Roxanne & Juan.Roxanne: Juan taught Wallace, and Wallace became Champion. I'd like to take notes on his battling today.
Roxanne & Juan.Juan: Ahh, Roxanne! A scholar of stone. Let our Hoenn art, rock and water, sculpt your defeat.

Roxanne & Wally.Roxanne: Wally earned my badge, didn't he? He's grown so much. I'm happy to battle alongside him.
Roxanne & Wally.Wally: Roxanne was my very first Gym battle! Now we're partners. I want to make Hoenn proud!

Roxanne & Anabel.Roxanne: Anabel was a Frontier Brain in Hoenn. I studied the Battle Frontier's records for months.
Roxanne & Anabel.Anabel: Roxanne's bond with her Pokémon is very steady. Like stone. Hoenn's Trainers won't fall easily.

Brawly & Wattson.Brawly: Wattson's got energy like a big wave! Dewford and Mauville, let's ride this one together!
Brawly & Wattson.Wattson: Wahahahah! Brawly's sea breeze and my lightning! Hoenn's having a thunderstorm today!

Brawly & Flannery.Brawly: Flannery's hot, I'm cool, like the ocean breeze. Hoenn's big wave is coming for you!
Brawly & Flannery.Flannery: Brawly surfed all the way here? I'll bring the heat, Brawly. You bring the waves!

Brawly & Norman.Brawly: Norman's the strongest guy in Hoenn. Teaming up with him? That's the biggest wave I've caught!
Brawly & Norman.Norman: Brawly's Fighting types and my Normal types share one thing: strength. Let's show it.

Brawly & Winona.Brawly: Winona's birds ride the wind, I ride the waves. Hoenn's sky and sea, coming at you!
Brawly & Winona.Winona: Brawly's Fighting types hit hard. My Flying types hit from above. Shall we?

Brawly & Juan.Brawly: Juan's the Water master of Sootopolis! Me, I just love the ocean. Let's make a splash!
Brawly & Juan.Juan: Brawly surfs with such passion! Ahh, Hoenn's seas inspire us both. Let's make art of this battle.

Brawly & Wally.Brawly: Wally's not that frail kid anymore! He hits like a wave now. Let's show 'em, partner!
Brawly & Wally.Wally: Brawly's Gym was my second badge. Now we're teammates! I'll fight with all I've got!

Brawly & Anabel.Brawly: Anabel can sense my team's spirit? Then she knows it's huge! Hoenn's coming for you!
Brawly & Anabel.Anabel: Brawly's bond with his Pokémon is strong and wild, like the sea. I like it. Let's battle.

Wattson & Flannery.Wattson: Wahahahah! Flannery's fire and my thunder! Hoenn's volcano and storm, all in one battle!
Wattson & Flannery.Flannery: Wattson laughs so much, it's contagious! Mauville and Lavaridge, let's light this place up!

Wattson & Norman.Wattson: Wahahahah! Norman's so serious! Lighten up, partner. Hoenn's going to win anyway!
Wattson & Norman.Norman: Wattson's laughter fills the room. His Electric types fill the battle. Let's go, old friend.

Wattson & Winona.Wattson: Wahahahah! Winona's birds are in for a shock... no, wait, we're on the same side! Go!
Wattson & Winona.Winona: Wattson, please aim away from my Flying types. Hoenn's sky will be ours together.

Wattson & Juan.Wattson: Wahahahah! Juan's water conducts my electricity beautifully! Hoenn's shocking art show begins!
Wattson & Juan.Juan: Wattson, your thunder makes my waters sparkle. Ahh, together we are a masterpiece.

Wattson & Wally.Wattson: Wahahahah! Wally once battled right outside my Mauville Gym! Gutsy kid! Let's go!
Wattson & Wally.Wally: Wattson is so cheerful! It makes me feel brave. Hoenn's going to win this!

Wattson & Anabel.Wattson: Wahahahah! Anabel, the Frontier Brain! Hoenn's Battle Frontier and Mauville, together!
Wattson & Anabel.Anabel: Wattson's energy is shocking. I sense his Pokémon love him dearly. Let's battle together.

Flannery & Norman.Flannery: Norman's so cool and calm. I'm trying to be like that! Hoenn's fiercest, let's go!
Flannery & Norman.Norman: Flannery has her grandfather's fire. Use it well, Lavaridge. Hoenn will win this battle.

Flannery & Winona.Flannery: Winona's so graceful. Me? I'm all fire! Lavaridge and Fortree, let's heat up the sky!
Flannery & Winona.Winona: Flannery's flames light up Hoenn's sky. Let's soar above this challenger together.

Flannery & Juan.Flannery: Juan's water could put my fire out... but today we're teammates! Hoenn, here we come!
Flannery & Juan.Juan: Ahh, Flannery! Fire and water dance together. A Hoenn masterpiece of steam and splendor!

Flannery & Wally.Flannery: Wally came to Lavaridge's hot springs to build up his health, and look at him now! Let's heat things up!
Flannery & Wally.Wally: Flannery's hot springs helped me get stronger. Now I'll repay her with a win!

Flannery & Anabel.Flannery: Anabel's so calm and collected! I'm all fired up! Hoenn's ready to win this one!
Flannery & Anabel.Anabel: Flannery's bond with her Pokémon burns brightly. I can feel it from here. Let's battle.

Norman & Winona.Norman: Winona's birds are a sight to behold. Petalburg and Fortree, let's show Hoenn's strength.
Norman & Winona.Winona: Norman's strength is legendary in Hoenn. With him on the ground, my birds rule the sky.

Norman & Juan.Norman: Juan taught the Champion. I taught my child. Hoenn's teachers don't lose easily.
Norman & Juan.Juan: Norman, ahh, such quiet strength. Let us show this challenger Hoenn's grace and might.

Norman & Wally.Norman: Wally caught his first Pokémon with my help in Petalburg. Look at him now. Let's battle, Wally.
Norman & Wally.Wally: Norman helped me catch my very first Pokémon when I was just starting out. I'll make him proud today!

Norman & Anabel.Norman: Anabel was a Frontier Brain. Hoenn's toughest facility. I'm glad she's on our side.
Norman & Anabel.Anabel: Norman's bond with his Pokémon is steady, like a father's. Hoenn's Trainers are strong.

Winona & Juan.Winona: Juan's art and my birds' grace. Hoenn's sky and sea will move together.
Winona & Juan.Juan: Winona's wings and my waters. Ahh, a duet of sky and sea! Hoenn's finest art!

Winona & Wally.Winona: Wally used to be too weak to climb Fortree's treetops. Now he's climbed the Battle Tree.
Winona & Wally.Wally: Winona's birds are so beautiful! I'll fight hard so they can soar!

Winona & Anabel.Winona: Anabel senses bonds, and my birds feel the wind. Hoenn's quiet Trainers are its strongest.
Winona & Anabel.Anabel: Winona's bond with her birds is light, like feathers. But strong. Let's battle together.

Juan & Wally.Juan: Ahh, Wally! You battled through Victory Road itself. A Hoenn star is born! Let us shine together!
Juan & Wally.Wally: Juan taught Wallace, and Wallace inspired me! I want to show Juan how far I've come!

Juan & Anabel.Juan: Anabel, the Salon Maiden! Ahh, Hoenn's Battle Frontier and Sootopolis, an elegant duet!
Juan & Anabel.Anabel: Juan's bond with his Pokémon is like a dance. I sense harmony. Let's battle together.

Wally & Anabel.Wally: Anabel was a Frontier Brain when I was still training! Hoenn's not losing today!
Wally & Anabel.Anabel: Wally's bond with his Pokémon grew as he did. I can sense how strong it is now. Let's go.

Roark & Gardenia.Roark: Gardenia's Grass types grow right out of my rocks. Oreburgh and Eterna, Sinnoh's first two badges!
Roark & Gardenia.Gardenia: Roark spends all day underground? No thanks. Just keep any Old Chateau ghosts away from me, okay?

Roark & Fantina.Roark: Fantina's ghosts give me the creeps. Still, Oreburgh's rocks can anchor any Hearthome show.
Roark & Fantina.Fantina: Roark, mon ami! Your team is so... how you say... rugged! Let us put on a Sinnoh spectacle!

Roark & Maylene.Roark: Maylene's Fighting types smash boulders for training. Glad my Rock types are on her side today!
Roark & Maylene.Maylene: Roark's rocks are tough. My fists are tougher. I... I think. Let's do this for Sinnoh!

Roark & Crasher Wake.Roark: Crasher Wake shook the whole mine just by shouting hello. My Rock types are ready, Wake!
Roark & Crasher Wake.Crasher Wake: The miner of Oreburgh! Rock and Water, the Crasher Wake tag team is on! WAHAHAH!

Roark & Byron.Roark: Dad's my partner?! Fine, Byron. Let's see whose Rock and Steel team is really number one!
Roark & Byron.Byron: Gahahah! My boy Roark! Oreburgh's rocks and Canalave's steel, father and son! Nothing breaks us!

Roark & Candice.Roark: Candice keeps yelling 'focus!' at me. I'm focused! Snowpoint ice on Oreburgh rock, let's go!
Roark & Candice.Candice: Roark, FOCUS! Rock types don't mind the cold, right? Then Snowpoint and Oreburgh can't lose!

Roark & Volkner.Roark: Volkner's Sinnoh's last Gym and I'm its first. Together, we cover every badge you could earn.
Roark & Volkner.Volkner: The first badge of Sinnoh. Let's see if Oreburgh can make this more interesting than Sunyshore.

Roark & Cynthia.Roark: Teaming up with Champion Cynthia? Oreburgh's fossil fanatic won't let Sinnoh down!
Roark & Cynthia.Cynthia: Roark digs up fossils, and I dig up legends. Sinnoh's history is on our side. Shall we?

Gardenia & Fantina.Gardenia: F-F-Fantina's my partner?! Your ghosts aren't from the Old Chateau, are they?! Are they?!
Gardenia & Fantina.Fantina: Gardenia, ma chérie, you tremble! My ghosts are friends. Eterna and Hearthome, together, oui?

Gardenia & Maylene.Gardenia: Maylene walks barefoot through Eterna Forest with me. We're both nature girls at heart!
Gardenia & Maylene.Maylene: Gardenia's flowers look delicate, but they're tough, like Veilstone's fighters. Let's battle!

Gardenia & Crasher Wake.Gardenia: Crasher Wake's rain makes my Grass types grow big and strong! Pastoria's marsh would be jealous!
Gardenia & Crasher Wake.Crasher Wake: Gardenia's Grass types love the Great Marsh! Water and Grass, the Crasher Wake jungle match!

Gardenia & Byron.Gardenia: Byron says the Old Chateau is just an old house. Easy for a guy made of steel to say!
Gardenia & Byron.Byron: Gahahah! Gardenia's scared of ghosts? My Steel types fear nothing! Canalave's got your back!

Gardenia & Candice.Gardenia: Candice's ice is gonna be gentle with my Grass types, right? Right?! Okay, let's go, Sinnoh!
Gardenia & Candice.Candice: Gardenia, focus! Grass under snow grows back stronger! Snowpoint and Eterna, team spirit!

Gardenia & Volkner.Gardenia: Volkner looks so bored. Don't worry, my Grass types will make this battle fun for both of us!
Gardenia & Volkner.Volkner: Gardenia's energy is... a lot. Maybe that's what this battle needs. Let's see.

Gardenia & Cynthia.Gardenia: Cynthia studies the old statue in Eterna City, right by my Gym! The Champion and Eterna's Leader, let's grow a win!
Gardenia & Cynthia.Cynthia: Gardenia keeps Eterna Forest safe while I study the statue in her city. Eterna's pride, together.

Fantina & Maylene.Fantina: Maylene, such strength in such a small Trainer! Ghost and Fighting, a duet magnifique!
Fantina & Maylene.Maylene: Fantina's dance moves are amazing. My moves are... punches. But together, I think we can win!

Fantina & Crasher Wake.Fantina: Crasher Wake, you are so loud! But on stage, loud is good! Hearthome and Pastoria, allons-y!
Fantina & Crasher Wake.Crasher Wake: Fantina's contest flair and the Crasher Wake! Ghost and Water, the dramatic tag team! WAHAHAH!

Fantina & Byron.Fantina: Byron, your Steel types shine like contest costumes! Together, we are a très grand show!
Fantina & Byron.Byron: Gahahah! Fantina's ghosts and my steel! I don't understand half of what she says, but let's win!

Fantina & Candice.Fantina: Candice, your Ice types dance on snow like my ghosts dance in the dark! A chilling ballet!
Fantina & Candice.Candice: Fantina, FOCUS! Ghost and Ice, a snowy haunted stage! We'll share the spotlight! Let's go!

Fantina & Volkner.Fantina: Volkner, you are bored? Non, non! With me, every battle is a spectacle! Sunyshore will shine!
Fantina & Volkner.Volkner: Fantina makes everything a performance. Fine. Let's give this challenger a show worth watching.

Fantina & Cynthia.Fantina: Cynthia, the Champion! Ahh, Sinnoh's grace and my ghosts' charm. Une bataille magnifique!
Fantina & Cynthia.Cynthia: Fantina's Ghost types know the old Sinnoh tales as well as I do. Let's add a new one.

Maylene & Crasher Wake.Maylene: Crasher Wake's a wrestler, I'm a fighter! He says my punches could go pro. Let's prove it!
Maylene & Crasher Wake.Crasher Wake: Maylene's fists and my wrestling moves! The Crasher Wake tag team title match! WAHAHAH!

Maylene & Byron.Maylene: Byron told me to wear shoes up the tree. I didn't. Veilstone and Canalave, let's go!
Maylene & Byron.Byron: Gahahah! Barefoot on this tree?! That's guts! Maylene's fists and my steel, unstoppable!

Maylene & Candice.Maylene: Candice says toughness is all in your head. I go barefoot, she wears a skirt in blizzards. Let's win!
Maylene & Candice.Candice: Maylene, FOCUS! Barefoot on a tree, a skirt in a blizzard: Sinnoh girls don't feel the cold! Let's go!

Maylene & Volkner.Maylene: Volkner's the strongest Leader in Sinnoh. I'll do my best to make him take us seriously!
Maylene & Volkner.Volkner: Maylene's gotten stronger since Veilstone. Let's see if she can keep this battle from being dull.

Maylene & Cynthia.Maylene: Fighting alongside Champion Cynthia! I can feel her team's aura from here! Sinnoh's shining today!
Maylene & Cynthia.Cynthia: Maylene's team has a fine aura, as fierce as her fists. Let's see if you can feel it.

Crasher Wake & Byron.Crasher Wake: Byron! The steel giant of Canalave! Water and Steel, Sinnoh's heavyweight tag team! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake & Byron.Byron: Gahahah! Crasher Wake's loud! But I'm louder! Canalave and Pastoria, let's crush this kid!

Crasher Wake & Candice.Crasher Wake: Candice! The Crasher Wake hails from Pastoria's marsh, she hails from the snow! Water and Ice!
Crasher Wake & Candice.Candice: Crasher Wake, FOCUS! Your waves and my snow, a Snowpoint storm! Let's go!

Crasher Wake & Volkner.Crasher Wake: Volkner! Sunyshore's lightning and the Crasher Wake's waves! Don't zap me, partner! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake & Volkner.Volkner: Crasher Wake's water and my lightning. Stand clear, Wake. This might actually be fun.

Crasher Wake & Cynthia.Crasher Wake: Cynthia! The Champion of Sinnoh! The Crasher Wake tag team just went legendary! WAHAHAH!
Crasher Wake & Cynthia.Cynthia: Crasher Wake brings the energy. I'll bring the Champion's resolve. Sinnoh's strength, together. Shall we?

Byron & Candice.Byron: Gahahah! Candice's ice and my steel! Snowpoint and Canalave, Sinnoh's coldest, hardest team!
Byron & Candice.Candice: Byron, FOCUS! Steel doesn't crack in the cold! Canalave and Snowpoint, unbreakable!

Byron & Volkner.Byron: Gahahah! Volkner's bored? Watch my steel wall tank everything! That'll wake you up!
Byron & Volkner.Volkner: Byron's loud enough to keep me awake. His steel holds the line, my lightning finishes. Let's go.

Byron & Cynthia.Byron: Gahahah! Cynthia, the Champion! Sinnoh's steel and Sinnoh's legends, together!
Byron & Cynthia.Cynthia: Byron digs up Sinnoh's past in the mines. I study its legends. A fine match. Let's battle.

Candice & Volkner.Candice: Volkner, FOCUS! Ice and Electric, Snowpoint and Sunyshore! We're gonna win, I know it!
Candice & Volkner.Volkner: Candice's focus is exhausting. Maybe that's the point. Sinnoh's shock and chill, let's go.

Candice & Cynthia.Candice: Cynthia, the Champion! FOCUS, Candice! Snowpoint's best won't let Sinnoh's Champion down!
Candice & Cynthia.Cynthia: Candice's focus is admirable. Snowpoint's ice and the Champion's resolve. Let's show you Sinnoh's strength.

Volkner & Cynthia.Volkner: Cynthia. The only Trainer in Sinnoh who never bores me. This might be fun after all.
Volkner & Cynthia.Cynthia: Volkner finally looks interested. Sunyshore's lightning and the Champion of Sinnoh. Let's begin.

Cheren & Roxie.Cheren: Roxie's Gym is the second one new Trainers face after mine. Today's lesson: Unova teamwork.
Cheren & Roxie.Roxie: Cheren's a teacher? Ugh, school. Fine, Teach. Let's make this loud and poisonous! Virbank rocks!

Cheren & Burgh.Cheren: Burgh sees art in every battle. I see logic. Either way, Unova's Leaders will see your defeat.
Cheren & Burgh.Burgh: Cheren's battles are so precise, like a sketch with no wasted lines! A Unova masterpiece awaits!

Cheren & Elesa.Cheren: Elesa's battles dazzle. Mine teach. Between Nimbasa and Aspertia, you'll learn something today.
Cheren & Elesa.Elesa: Cheren's a bit serious for the runway, but he's sharp! Unova's Leaders, strike a pose!

Cheren & Clay.Cheren: Clay built Driftveil with hard work and stubbornness. I teach my students the first one. Let's battle.
Cheren & Clay.Clay: Cheren, the schoolteacher! Teach this kid that Unova don't hand out wins for free!

Cheren & Skyla.Cheren: Skyla delivers cargo across Unova; I deliver lessons. Today, we'll deliver a defeat.
Cheren & Skyla.Skyla: Cheren's so serious! Loosen up, flyboy! Mistralton and Aspertia are taking off together!

Cheren & Drayden.Cheren: Drayden taught Iris everything. I hope to teach my students half as well. Let's battle, sir.
Cheren & Drayden.Drayden: Cheren has grown into a fine teacher. Opelucid and Aspertia, Unova's wisdom, together.

Cheren & Marlon.Cheren: Marlon's Gym is the last in Unova, and mine is the first. Together, we cover a Trainer's whole journey.
Cheren & Marlon.Marlon: Cheren, dude, you gotta relax! Aspertia's first and Humilau's last, the whole Unova wave!

Cheren & Chili.Cheren: Chili, please don't rush in before I explain the plan. Unova's Leaders work best with a strategy.
Cheren & Chili.Chili: Cheren's got a plan? Cool! I'll just set everything on fire while he explains it! Let's go!

Cheren & Cress.Cheren: Cress analyzes everything, like I do. Unova's most logical Leaders. Shall we begin?
Cheren & Cress.Cress: Cheren and I both value clear thinking. A refined Unova partnership. Let's battle elegantly.

Cheren & Cilan.Cheren: Cilan says he can taste the flavor of a battle. I'll trust his palate and my plan.
Cheren & Cilan.Cilan: Cheren! Your battle style has a crisp, logical flavor! Paired with my Grass types, a fine Unova course!

Cheren & Lenora.Cheren: Lenora's Normal types taught me how strong 'ordinary' can be. Two Unova Normal-type Leaders, together.
Cheren & Lenora.Lenora: Cheren uses Normal types too! History says the simplest tools last longest. Let's prove it, Teacher!

Cheren & Brycen.Cheren: Brycen was an action star. I'm a teacher. We both believe in discipline. Let's battle.
Cheren & Brycen.Brycen: Cheren's discipline rivals any Pokéstar Studios stunt crew. Unova's resolve, together. Hm!

Cheren & Bianca.Cheren: Bianca and I have been friends since we were kids in Nuvema. Don't trip on the stairs, Bianca.
Cheren & Bianca.Bianca: Cheren! You're my partner! Just like old times! I promise I won't drop my Poké Balls this time!

Cheren & Grimsley.Cheren: Grimsley gambles. I calculate. Strange partners for Unova, but the math says we win.
Cheren & Grimsley.Grimsley: The teacher from Aspertia. I'll bet on your lesson plan, Cheren. Unova's Elite and its finest Leader.

Cheren & Colress.Cheren: Colress worked with Team Plasma. Today he's on my side. Unova has changed a lot, hasn't it?
Cheren & Colress.Colress: Cheren, the logical Leader. Your Normal types are an excellent control group for my research.

Roxie & Burgh.Roxie: Burgh paints, I sing! Unova's art scene is taking over this battle! Get ready for the encore!
Roxie & Burgh.Burgh: Roxie's music is so raw! Her poison and my bugs, a punk-rock painting! Unova, inspire me!

Roxie & Elesa.Roxie: Elesa's a supermodel, I'm a rock star! Unova's celebrities are on tour, and you're the opening act!
Roxie & Elesa.Elesa: Roxie's stage presence is electrifying! Nimbasa's runway and Virbank's stage, together!

Roxie & Clay.Roxie: Clay's a grumpy old miner. I'm a grumpy young singer. Unova's grumpiest team, let's go!
Roxie & Clay.Clay: Roxie's music is too loud for an old miner! But she's tough. Driftveil and Virbank, let's dig in!

Roxie & Skyla.Roxie: Skyla flies cargo, I fly on stage! Unova's coolest girls are taking off! Get hyped!
Roxie & Skyla.Skyla: Roxie's poison and my birds! We're gonna fly circles and leave a toxic trail! Unova, takeoff!

Roxie & Drayden.Roxie: Drayden's a mayor, so he's probably gonna lecture me. Whatever. Unova's toughest, let's rock!
Roxie & Drayden.Drayden: Roxie, the young singer from Virbank. Unova's spirit comes in many forms. Let's battle.

Roxie & Marlon.Roxie: Marlon's a surfer, I'm a singer! Unova's chillest and loudest Leaders! Let's make some noise!
Roxie & Marlon.Marlon: Roxie's got some serious vibes, dude! Poison and Water, the Unova wave! Let's ride!

Roxie & Chili.Roxie: Chili's as loud as my band! Fire and poison, the hottest show in Unova! Let's go!
Roxie & Chili.Chili: Roxie's songs are FIRE! Literally, if I'm in the crowd! Unova's loudest team-up starts now!

Roxie & Cress.Roxie: Cress is too fancy for a punk show. But he's on my team today, so let's poison 'em!
Roxie & Cress.Cress: Roxie's music is quite... unrefined. Yet strangely invigorating. Shall we, Unova's punk?

Roxie & Cilan.Roxie: Cilan says my battles taste spicy. Cool! Grass and poison, the Unova special!
Roxie & Cilan.Cilan: Roxie's battle style is a bold, toxic flavor! Paired with Grass, a perfect Unova pairing!

Roxie & Lenora.Roxie: Lenora's a museum director. Kinda old school. But she hits hard! Unova's best, let's go!
Roxie & Lenora.Lenora: Roxie, Virbank's rock star! History will remember this Unova team-up. Let's battle!

Roxie & Brycen.Roxie: Brycen was a movie star! I'm a rock star! Unova's celebrity team-up! Get ready!
Roxie & Brycen.Brycen: Roxie's stage energy rivals any film set. Unova's performers, together. Hm!

Roxie & Bianca.Roxie: Bianca's so clumsy, she tripped on my guitar cable! Still, she's tough. Unova, let's rock!

Lt. Surge & Wattson.Lt. Surge: Wattson, you old sparkplug! Vermilion and Mauville, the most electrifying team on the planet!
Lt. Surge & Wattson.Wattson: Wahahahah! Lt. Surge! Kanto's lightning and Hoenn's thunder! Shocking, isn't it?!

Lt. Surge & Volkner.Lt. Surge: Volkner looks bored, kid! Let's give him a jolt! Vermilion and Sunyshore, full voltage!
Lt. Surge & Volkner.Volkner: Lt. Surge never stops shouting. At least his team's strong. Kanto and Sinnoh's lightning, go.

Lt. Surge & Elesa.Lt. Surge: Elesa's a supermodel AND an Electric-type pro! Vermilion and Nimbasa, maximum voltage, kid!
Lt. Surge & Elesa.Elesa: Lt. Surge's thunder and my sparks! Kanto's lightning and Unova's spotlight, dazzling!

Wattson & Volkner.Wattson: Wahahahah! Volkner! Mauville's power and Sunyshore's solar panels! A shocking team!
Wattson & Volkner.Volkner: Wattson's Mauville and my Sunyshore both run on electricity. Fitting. Let's light this up.

Wattson & Elesa.Wattson: Wahahahah! Elesa's runway glows brighter than Mauville's arcade! Both our cities run on electricity!
Wattson & Elesa.Elesa: Wattson's laugh is pure static! Mauville and Nimbasa, let's give them a dazzling shock!

Volkner & Elesa.Volkner: Elesa. Unova's Electric-type star. Finally, someone who might make this interesting.
Volkner & Elesa.Elesa: Volkner looks bored? I'll fix that. Sunyshore's lighthouse and Nimbasa's spotlight, full charge!

Erika & Gardenia.Erika: Gardenia's flowers have the loveliest fragrance. Celadon and Eterna, a garden in full bloom.

Erika & Mallow.Mallow: Erika's flowers smell amazing! I wanna use them in a recipe! Grass types, Kanto and Alola!

Gardenia & Cilan.Gardenia: Cilan says my battles taste fresh, like a forest salad! Eterna and Striaton, let's grow!
Gardenia & Cilan.Cilan: Gardenia's battles have a fresh, forest-green flavor! A Grass-type feast! Evaluation time!

Gardenia & Mallow.Gardenia: Mallow's Lush Jungle is like Eterna Forest, but sunnier! Grass types, Sinnoh and Alola!
Gardenia & Mallow.Mallow: Gardenia's forest is beautiful! I wanna cook with its berries! Grass types, let's bloom!

Cilan & Mallow.Cilan: Mallow is a chef AND a Grass-type Trainer?! A kindred spirit! It's evaluation time!
Cilan & Mallow.Mallow: Cilan's a connoisseur? Let's cook up a win! Grass types, Unova and Alola, the ultimate menu!

Janine & Roxie.Janine: Roxie's poison is loud, mine is silent. Fuchsia's ninja and Virbank's rock star, the deadliest duo!
Janine & Roxie.Roxie: Janine's a ninja?! So cool! Poison types, Kanto and Unova, let's make some noise!

Janine & Plumeria.Plumeria: Janine's a ninja, huh? Fine. Just don't hide when it's time to fight. Poison types, let's go.

Roxie & Plumeria.Roxie: Plumeria's Team Skull? That's so punk! Poison types, Unova and Alola, let's rock!
Roxie & Plumeria.Plumeria: Roxie's got attitude. I like it. Poison types, let's show this kid what toxic really means.

Sabrina & Dexio.Dexio: Sabrina's psychic powers are legendary. I'm honored to battle beside her. Kalos and Kanto, focus.

Sabrina & Anabel.Anabel: Sabrina's mind is sharp as a blade. I can sense her Pokémon's trust. Let's battle together.

Dexio & Anabel.Dexio: Anabel was a Frontier Brain. Her Psychic types are formidable. Kalos and Hoenn, let's begin.
Dexio & Anabel.Anabel: Dexio's bond with his Pokémon is quiet but strong. I sense it. Let's battle together.

Blaine & Flannery.Blaine: Hah! Flannery took over her grandpa's Gym, and I rebuilt mine after a volcano blew it up! Fire-type Leaders never quit!
Blaine & Flannery.Flannery: Blaine kept his Gym going even after Cinnabar's volcano erupted! That's the Leader I want to be! Let's heat it up!

Blaine & Chili.Chili: Blaine's quizzes are awesome! Answer: the challenger's about to get roasted! Fire types, let's go!

Blaine & Kiawe.Kiawe: Blaine's Gym survived an eruption, and his fire never went out! Akala's captain salutes you! Let's burn!

Flannery & Chili.Flannery: Chili's even more fired up than me! Lavaridge's hot springs and Striaton's hot sauce, let's get spicy!
Flannery & Chili.Chili: Flannery gets it! Fire's all about passion! Lavaridge and Striaton, crank up the heat!

Flannery & Kiawe.Flannery: Kiawe's fire dance is so cool! Maybe I'll try it at the Lavaridge hot springs! Let's burn it up!
Flannery & Kiawe.Kiawe: Flannery's spirit burns like Wela Volcano itself! Lavaridge and Akala, volcano Trainers unite!

Chili & Kiawe.Chili: Kiawe's a fire dancer, and I'm a fire waiter! Same energy! Let's serve up some flames!
Chili & Kiawe.Kiawe: Chili's passion rivals the flames of Wela Volcano! Fire types, our blaze will not die out!

Bugsy & Burgh.Bugsy: Burgh paints Bug types, and I research them! Azalea and Castelia, the Bug-type experts' summit!
Bugsy & Burgh.Burgh: Bugsy knows every Bug type by heart, and I know them by color! Together, a Bug-type masterpiece!

Bugsy & Guzma.Guzma: A Bug-type nerd, huh? Fine. Watch big bad Guzma and write this down: destruction!

Burgh & Guzma.Burgh: Guzma's Bug types are a sculpture of pure power! How inspiring!
Burgh & Guzma.Guzma: An artist with Bug types? Whatever. Paint a picture of big bad Guzma smashin' this kid!

Norman & Cheren.Cheren: Norman's team is a lesson in raw power. Petalburg and Aspertia, Normal types, side by side.

Norman & Lenora.Norman: Lenora understands that Normal types are anything but ordinary. Petalburg and Nacrene, let's prove it.
Norman & Lenora.Lenora: Norman's battles are the stuff of Hoenn legend! Let's make some Unova history too! Normal types, together!

Morty & Fantina.Morty: Fantina's Ghost types move like dancers. Ecruteak and Hearthome, a mystical pairing.

Jasmine & Colress.Colress: Jasmine's bond with her Steel types is quiet but powerful. Let's see how far it can go.

Pryce & Brycen.Brycen: Pryce has endured more winters than I have. I'll follow his lead. Hm!

Candice & Sina.Sina: Candice's energy is contagious! Ice types from Sinnoh and Kalos, let's freeze this battle!

Brycen & Sina.Brycen: Sina's cheer warms even an icy heart. Icirrus and Kalos, together. Hm!

Lorelei & Sina.Sina: Lorelei, an ice master from Kanto! Dexio is going to be so jealous!

Bruno & Brock.Bruno: Brock! Rock-solid as always. Stand firm beside me!
Bruno & Brock.Brock: Bruno, I'm taking notes on your training regimen after this!

Bruno & Bugsy.Bruno: Bugsy! Small but sharp, like a well-placed jab!
Bruno & Bugsy.Bugsy: Bruno, I've researched your training methods. Very effective, statistically!

Bruno & Lt. Surge.Lt. Surge: Bruno! My drill sergeant would've loved you! Fall in, soldier!

Bruno & Marshal.Marshal: Bruno of the Elite Four. Your discipline is famous in Unova too. Let us begin.

Bruno & Maylene.Bruno: Maylene! Barefoot and fearless! I like your style!

Bruno & Morty.Bruno: Morty! You see the future? Then you know we'll win!

Bruno & Pryce.Bruno: Pryce! An elder of battle. I'll match your patience with power!

Bruno & Sabrina.Bruno: Sabrina! Mind and muscle, together at last!
Bruno & Sabrina.Sabrina: Bruno. I sense your next move: something very loud.

Bruno & Whitney.Bruno: Whitney! No tears today, win or lose! Fight hard!

Bruno & Will.Bruno: Will! The Johto Elite Four stands together!
Bruno & Will.Will: Bruno, try to be subtle. Just this once.

Lance & Diantha.Lance: Diantha, I've seen your films. Let's give them a real show.

Lance & Drasna.Lance: Drasna, your gentle way with dragons is admirable.

Lance & Drayden.Lance: Drayden, the dragon master of Opelucid. An honor.
Lance & Drayden.Drayden: Lance. Your name flies far. Let us see the dragons behind it.

Lance & Erika.Lance: Erika, your calm balances my dragons' fury.

Iris & Drayden.Iris: Drayden! Let's show them what we learned together in Opelucid!
Iris & Drayden.Drayden: Iris. You've grown into a fine Champion. Let us battle as one.

Iris & Elesa.Iris: Elesa! You're so pretty! Let's shine together!
Iris & Elesa.Elesa: Iris! Your energy is electric! You'd be a natural on the runway!

Iris & Grimsley.Iris: Grimsley! No gambling! We're gonna win for sure!
Iris & Grimsley.Grimsley: Iris. With you, the odds are always in our favor.

Iris & Lenora.Iris: Lenora! Your museum has so many cool dragon bones!
Iris & Lenora.Lenora: Iris. That skeleton you love is still on display. Let's make some history.

Iris & Marlon.Iris: Marlon! Let's ride the waves to victory! Can dragons surf?
Iris & Marlon.Marlon: Iris, dude! You're so energetic! Let's go!

Iris & Roxie.Iris: Roxie! Your band is so loud! Let's rock this battle!
Iris & Roxie.Roxie: Iris! The Champion's a total rock star! Let's rock!

Iris & Skyla.Iris: Skyla! Race you to the sky! My dragons are super fast!
Iris & Skyla.Skyla: Iris! Your dragons and my birds! Let's soar!

Malva & Blaine.Malva: Blaine, I'd interview you, but I suspect you'd answer in riddles.
Malva & Blaine.Blaine: Malva! Quiz for the reporter: what's hotter than breaking news? My volcano! Hah!

Malva & Chili.Malva: Chili, a hothead from Unova. Try not to embarrass us on camera.
Malva & Chili.Chili: Malva! A fire master on TV! Let's make the headlines sizzle!

Malva & Dexio.Malva: Dexio. Sycamore's assistant. Do try to keep up.
Malva & Dexio.Dexio: Malva. Your fire is formidable. I'll support you however I can.

Malva & Diantha.Malva: Diantha. Kalos's darling Champion. Let's give the cameras a show.
Malva & Diantha.Diantha: Malva, you always know how to make the headlines. Shall we write tonight's?

Malva & Drasna.Malva: Drasna, so sweet and so terrifying. My favorite kind of colleague.
Malva & Drasna.Drasna: Oh, Malva! The Kalos Elite Four together! How lovely!

Malva & Flannery.Malva: Flannery, Lavaridge's little flame. Let's see if you can keep up with me.
Malva & Flannery.Flannery: Malva! A fire master from Kalos! I'll burn just as bright, you'll see!

Malva & Kiawe.Malva: Kiawe, a fire dancer. Very telegenic. Don't let it go to your head.
Malva & Kiawe.Kiawe: Malva. Your flames are fierce. Let our fire dance together.

Malva & Siebold.Malva: Siebold, my colleague. Try to battle, not just cook.
Malva & Siebold.Siebold: Malva. Fire and water, like a well-seasoned broth. Let us begin.

Malva & Sina.Malva: Sina. Ice beside my fire. How... ironic.
Malva & Sina.Sina: Malva! Don't melt my ice, okay? We're on the same team!

Malva & Wikstrom.Malva: Wikstrom, please stop bowing to the camera. It isn't even on.
Malva & Wikstrom.Wikstrom: Malva! A knight's honor to battle beside you! Even off camera!

Siebold & Chili.Siebold: Chili, a chef of fire. Your passion is a spice all its own.
Siebold & Chili.Chili: Siebold! A real chef from Kalos! Let's cook up something spicy!

Siebold & Cilan.Siebold: Cilan, a connoisseur. Your palate must be exquisite.
Siebold & Cilan.Cilan: Siebold! This battle has the aroma of a Kalosian feast! Let's begin!

Siebold & Crasher Wake.Siebold: Crasher Wake, your water is wild. Mine is refined. Together, a balanced dish.
Siebold & Crasher Wake.Crasher Wake: Wahahah! Siebold! Let's make a splash so big it fills a soup pot!

Siebold & Cress.Siebold: Cress, a fellow master of water and service. How elegant.
Siebold & Cress.Cress: Siebold. Your cuisine is legendary. Let's serve them a defeat.

Siebold & Dexio.Siebold: Dexio. Professor Sycamore's assistant. I trust you're well fed.
Siebold & Dexio.Dexio: Siebold! I've eaten at your restaurant! It was incredible!

Siebold & Diantha.Siebold: Diantha, our Champion. Let us create a masterpiece.
Siebold & Diantha.Diantha: Siebold, your cooking and battling are both works of art. Shall we?

Siebold & Drasna.Siebold: Drasna, your kindness is like a warm soup. Let's begin.
Siebold & Drasna.Drasna: Oh, Siebold! I've missed your cooking! Let's win so you can make dinner!

Siebold & Juan.Siebold: Juan, an artist of water. I am honored.
Siebold & Juan.Juan: Siebold. A fellow artist. Let us make this battle a masterpiece.

Siebold & Mallow.Siebold: Mallow, a young chef of Alola. Tell me, what is your specialty?
Siebold & Mallow.Mallow: Siebold! A famous chef! Let's win, then cook together, okay?

Siebold & Marlon.Siebold: Marlon, your energy is like a fresh catch of the day.
Siebold & Marlon.Marlon: Siebold, dude! A chef who battles! Let's cook 'em!

Siebold & Misty.Siebold: Misty, Cerulean's water master. Let us make waves together.
Siebold & Misty.Misty: Siebold! A water master who cooks! Let's win and grab dinner!

Siebold & Sina.Siebold: Sina. Ice and water, like a chilled consommé. Refreshing.
Siebold & Sina.Sina: Siebold! Can you make me some shave ice after this? Please?

Siebold & Wikstrom.Siebold: Wikstrom, my colleague. Shall we serve our opponents a defeat?
Siebold & Wikstrom.Wikstrom: Siebold! A knight and a chef! A feast of victory awaits!

Wikstrom & Byron.Wikstrom: Byron! A fellow master of steel! Let us forge a victory!
Wikstrom & Byron.Byron: Gahaha! Wikstrom! A steel knight! Let's dig in!

Wikstrom & Colress.Wikstrom: Colress, a man of science and steel. I shall protect you!
Wikstrom & Colress.Colress: Wikstrom. Your armor is a fascinating feat of engineering.

Wikstrom & Dexio.Wikstrom: Dexio! A young scholar! Fear not, I shall defend you!
Wikstrom & Dexio.Dexio: Wikstrom! A real knight! Professor Sycamore won't believe this!

Wikstrom & Diantha.Wikstrom: Lady Diantha! It is my honor to fight at your side!
Wikstrom & Diantha.Diantha: Wikstrom, you're always so gallant. Let's win this for Kalos!

Wikstrom & Drasna.Wikstrom: Lady Drasna! A knight shall protect you!
Wikstrom & Drasna.Drasna: Oh, Wikstrom! You're always so chivalrous! Let's win!

Wikstrom & Jasmine.Wikstrom: Lady Jasmine! Your steel is gentle yet true!
Wikstrom & Jasmine.Jasmine: Wikstrom... you're so polite. I'll do my best.

Wikstrom & Molayne.Wikstrom: Molayne! A steel master from Alola! Let us stand firm!
Wikstrom & Molayne.Molayne: Wikstrom. A knight of steel. Let's see that armor in action.

Wikstrom & Sina.Wikstrom: Lady Sina! Your ice shall gleam beside my steel!
Wikstrom & Sina.Sina: Wikstrom! You're so gallant! Dexio could learn a thing or two from you!

Drasna & Clair.Drasna: Clair, a fellow dragon tamer! Your dragons look so proud!
Drasna & Clair.Clair: Drasna. Your gentleness is deceptive. I like it.

Drasna & Dexio.Drasna: Dexio, dear! Does Professor Sycamore know you're out here battling?
Drasna & Dexio.Dexio: Drasna! He does, and he said to learn everything I can from the Elite Four!

Drasna & Diantha.Drasna: Diantha, our Champion! Let's have a wonderful battle together!
Drasna & Diantha.Diantha: Drasna, your dragons are as lovely as you are. Let's win.

Drasna & Drayden.Drasna: Drayden, a dragon master from Unova! How lovely!
Drasna & Drayden.Drayden: Drasna. Your gentle hand with dragons is rare. Let us battle.

Drasna & Sina.Drasna: Sina, dear! Your ice sparkles so beautifully! Let's win together!
Drasna & Sina.Sina: Drasna! Your dragons look so friendly! Are they, though?

Diantha & Brycen.Diantha: Brycen! A fellow actor! I loved your films. Shall we share the stage?
Diantha & Brycen.Brycen: Diantha. A true star of the screen. Let us give them a final scene.

Diantha & Cynthia.Diantha: Cynthia, two Champions together. Let's make this a blockbuster.
Diantha & Cynthia.Cynthia: Diantha. Your poise is remarkable. Let's give them a show.

Diantha & Dexio.Diantha: Dexio! Professor Sycamore's assistant! Let's give them our best scene!
Diantha & Dexio.Dexio: Diantha! The Champion herself! I'll try not to miss my cue!

Diantha & Sina.Diantha: Sina! Your energy lights up the whole set! Let's shine together!
Diantha & Sina.Sina: Diantha! The Champion of Kalos! I'm your biggest fan!

Hala & Acerola.Hala: Acerola! Ula'ula's little Captain! Hoh! Your spirit is as big as my belly!
Hala & Acerola.Acerola: Hala! You laugh so loud the ghosts at the old Megamart hide! Let's win!

Hala & Brawly.Hala: Hoh! Brawly! A fighter who rides the waves! My grandson would love you!
Hala & Brawly.Brawly: Hala! A Kahuna who fights with his fists? That's totally gnarly!

Hala & Chuck.Hala: Hoh! Chuck! I hear you train under waterfalls. Melemele has a few you'd like!
Hala & Chuck.Chuck: WAHAHAH! Hala! Your laugh is as mighty as your punches!

Hala & Guzma.Hala: Guzma, my boy. I always knew there was good in you. Show me today.
Hala & Guzma.Guzma: Hala. Don't start, old man. ...Fine. Let's win this.

Hala & Kahili.Hala: Kahili! Back from your tour abroad! Hoh! How was the competition?
Hala & Kahili.Kahili: Hala. Tough, but not as tough as a Kahuna. Let's play this hole together.

Hala & Kiawe.Hala: Kiawe! I've seen your fire dance at the festival. Bring that passion here! Hoh!
Hala & Kiawe.Kiawe: Kahuna Hala! I'll burn with everything I have beside you!

Hala & Kukui.Hala: Kukui! The professor who gave Alola its League! Hoh! Let's honor it!
Hala & Kukui.Kukui: Hala! Woo! Battling beside the Kahuna who keeps the islands strong!

Hala & Mallow.Hala: Mallow! After this, I'm ordering everything at Aina's Kitchen! Hoh!
Hala & Mallow.Mallow: Hala! I'll cook up a feast big enough for even your appetite!

Hala & Maylene.Hala: Hoh! Maylene! Barefoot on the hot sand! You have a Kahuna's toughness!
Hala & Maylene.Maylene: Hala! You train like a true martial artist! Let's go all out!

Hala & Molayne.Hala: Molayne! Still gazing at the stars on Ula'ula? Hoh! Gaze at our win!
Hala & Molayne.Molayne: Hala. I'll calculate the trajectory. You supply the force.

Hala & Olivia.Hala: Olivia! Two Kahunas together! Hoh! Melemele and Akala, side by side!
Hala & Olivia.Olivia: Hala! Let's show them why the islands chose us!

Hala & Plumeria.Hala: Plumeria. Even Team Skull's big sister deserves a strong partner. Let's win.
Hala & Plumeria.Plumeria: Hala. Don't get sentimental on me, old man. Just fight.

Olivia & Acerola.Olivia: Acerola! Win this with me and I'll find you something sparkly at my shop!
Olivia & Acerola.Acerola: Olivia! A necklace with a little ghost charm, please! Hee hee!

Olivia & Brock.Olivia: Brock! A rock lover from Kanto? Okay, you're officially my favorite partner!
Olivia & Brock.Brock: Olivia! A Kahuna who sells gems! You're... wow. Um. I'll hold the line!

Olivia & Guzma.Olivia: Guzma. Behave yourself on my battlefield, got it?
Olivia & Guzma.Guzma: Olivia. Relax, Kahuna. Team Skull's on its best behavior. Mostly.

Olivia & Kahili.Olivia: Kahili! Golf can wait, the Elite Four needs you!
Olivia & Kahili.Kahili: Olivia. Your rocks make a fine bunker. I'll aim around them.

Olivia & Kiawe.Olivia: Kiawe! My island's fiery Captain! Show 'em that fire dance!
Olivia & Kiawe.Kiawe: Kahuna Olivia! Akala's fire burns for you!

Olivia & Kukui.Olivia: Kukui! You built the League, so you'd better not lose in it!
Olivia & Kukui.Kukui: Olivia! Woo! Akala's Kahuna rocks, literally!

Olivia & Mallow.Olivia: Mallow! Akala's sweetest Captain! Let's win and celebrate at your place!
Olivia & Mallow.Mallow: Olivia! I'll whip up something sparkly for my Kahuna!

Olivia & Molayne.Olivia: Molayne! Rock and steel! Nothing's getting through us!
Olivia & Molayne.Molayne: Olivia. Solid materials, solid plan. I approve.

Olivia & Plumeria.Olivia: Plumeria. I'm keeping an eye on you, girl.
Olivia & Plumeria.Plumeria: Olivia. Watch all you want, Kahuna. I'm here to win.

Olivia & Roark.Olivia: Roark! A miner! You must find amazing stones! Wanna trade?
Olivia & Roark.Roark: Olivia! A Kahuna with a jewelry shop! Let's dig in!

Olivia & Roxanne.Olivia: Roxanne! A rock scholar! Bet you'd love Akala's fossils!
Olivia & Roxanne.Roxanne: Olivia! I've read about Alola's geology! Let's put theory into practice!

Acerola & Fantina.Acerola: Fantina! Do your ghosts like to dance? Mine love it!
Acerola & Fantina.Fantina: Acerola! Ze little ghost princess! Oui, we dance!

Acerola & Guzma.Acerola: Guzma! Be nice, okay? Some of the kids at the Aether House think you're cool.
Acerola & Guzma.Guzma: Acerola. Tell the brats Big Bad Guzma says hi. Now let's go.

Acerola & Kahili.Acerola: Kahili! Teach me golf after this? I promise not to haunt your clubs!
Acerola & Kahili.Kahili: Acerola. Deal. Just keep your ghosts off the fairway.

Acerola & Kiawe.Acerola: Kiawe! Captain buddies! Even your fire can't scare my ghosts!
Acerola & Kiawe.Kiawe: Acerola! Your ghosts and my fire! A spooky bonfire!

Acerola & Kukui.Acerola: Professor Kukui! You should study ghost moves! They're the best!
Acerola & Kukui.Kukui: Acerola! Woo! Spooky moves! I'm taking notes!

Acerola & Mallow.Acerola: Mallow! Let's win so you can make that sweet treat you promised!
Acerola & Mallow.Mallow: Acerola! I'll make your favorite! Spooky-sweet!

Acerola & Molayne.Acerola: Molayne! You used to be a Captain too, right? Let's do our best!
Acerola & Molayne.Molayne: Acerola. Former Captain and current Elite Four. Let's be efficient.

Acerola & Morty.Acerola: Morty! You can see spirits too? Wanna be spooky friends?
Acerola & Morty.Morty: Acerola. The spirits around you are... giggling. Fascinating.

Acerola & Plumeria.Acerola: Plumeria! The kids say you're actually really nice!
Acerola & Plumeria.Plumeria: Acerola. Don't spread that around, kid. Let's win.

Kahili & Falkner.Kahili: Falkner, a fellow lover of the sky. Let's read the wind together.
Kahili & Falkner.Falkner: Kahili! An Elite Four master of birds! Let's take to the skies!

Kahili & Guzma.Kahili: Guzma. Keep your temper on the fairway, would you?
Kahili & Guzma.Guzma: Kahili. Sure, golf lady. Just don't slow me down.

Kahili & Kiawe.Kahili: Kiawe. Your fire could warm up a cold morning round.
Kahili & Kiawe.Kiawe: Kahili! It's an honor to battle beside the Elite Four!

Kahili & Kukui.Kahili: Professor Kukui. You built the League I came home for.
Kahili & Kukui.Kukui: Kahili! Woo! Glad you came back to Alola, yeah?

Kahili & Mallow.Kahili: Mallow. A good meal after a good round. That's the plan.
Kahili & Mallow.Mallow: Kahili! I'll make you a power lunch for your next tournament!

Kahili & Molayne.Kahili: Molayne. You calculate angles too. We'll get along.
Kahili & Molayne.Molayne: Kahili. Trajectories, wind speed... yes, we'll get along.

Kahili & Plumeria.Kahili: Plumeria. Stay out of the rough.
Kahili & Plumeria.Plumeria: Kahili. I'm always in the rough, golf lady. Let's win.

Kahili & Skyla.Kahili: Skyla, a pilot. You understand the wind like I do.
Kahili & Skyla.Skyla: Kahili! A golfer who reads the wind! Let's soar!

Kahili & Winona.Kahili: Winona, a fellow master of the sky. Let's soar.
Kahili & Winona.Winona: Kahili, your birds are as graceful as your swing.

Molayne & Byron.Molayne: Byron, a steel master from Sinnoh. Let's see how your steel holds up.
Molayne & Byron.Byron: Gahaha! Molayne! Alolan steel! Let's dig in!

Molayne & Colress.Molayne: Colress. A fellow engineer. Let's see your science in action.
Molayne & Colress.Colress: Molayne. Your engineering mind is fascinating. Let's begin.

Molayne & Guzma.Molayne: Guzma. Simple plan: you smash, I calculate.
Molayne & Guzma.Guzma: Molayne. Calculate all you want. I'm still smashing.

Molayne & Jasmine.Molayne: Jasmine, a steel master from Johto. Gentle, but strong. I like that.
Molayne & Jasmine.Jasmine: Molayne... you're so calm. I'll do my best beside you.

Molayne & Kiawe.Molayne: Kiawe. Fire and steel. A forge, really.
Molayne & Kiawe.Kiawe: Molayne! Let's forge a victory in Wela's flames!

Molayne & Kukui.Molayne: Professor Kukui. You built the League; I'll build us a strategy.

Molayne & Mallow.Molayne: Mallow. I'll trade you a look through the telescope for a plate of your cooking.
Molayne & Mallow.Mallow: Molayne! Deal! I've always wanted to see the stars up close!

Kukui & Crasher Wake.Kukui: Crasher Wake! A fellow masked wrestler! Woo! Let's put on a show!
Kukui & Crasher Wake.Crasher Wake: Wahahah! Kukui! I know a wrestler when I see one! Let's slam them!

Kukui & Guzma.Kukui: Guzma! Let's show 'em Alola's tough guys can work together, yeah?
Kukui & Guzma.Guzma: Kukui. Don't get cute, Professor. Just keep up.

Kukui & Kiawe.Kukui: Kiawe! Your fire dance is the best move in Alola! Woo!
Kukui & Kiawe.Kiawe: Professor! I'll show you a move worth studying!

Kukui & Mallow.Kukui: Mallow! After this, let's grab a bite at your place! Woo!
Kukui & Mallow.Mallow: Professor Kukui! I'll cook you a victory feast!

Kukui & Plumeria.Kukui: Plumeria! Let's make this a good one, yeah?
Kukui & Plumeria.Plumeria: Professor. Don't get preachy. Let's just win.

Archer & Ariana.Archer: Ariana. Two executives, one goal: show them Team Rocket is still standing.
Archer & Ariana.Ariana: Archer. Try to keep up. I'm not carrying you through this one.

Archer & Bruno.Archer: Bruno of the Elite Four. Your fists for our cause... just for today.
Archer & Bruno.Bruno: Hmph! I fight beside you once, Rocket. Don't get used to it!

Archer & Bugsy.Archer: The Azalea bug boy. Don't look at me like that; the well business was Proton's idea.
Archer & Bugsy.Bugsy: Archer. I haven't forgotten what you did at the well in Azalea. Let's just win and part ways.

Archer & Chuck.Archer: Cianwood's brawler. Loud, but useful. Point that energy forward.
Archer & Chuck.Chuck: Team Rocket?! WAHAHAH! Fine, I'll punch whoever's in front of me!

Archer & Clair.Archer: The Blackthorn dragon tamer. Your cousin gave us a lot of trouble.
Archer & Clair.Clair: Archer. And I'll give you even more if you get in my way.

Archer & Falkner.Archer: Violet's bird keeper. Keep your flock in line and we'll get along.
Archer & Falkner.Falkner: My birds fly for Violet City, not for Team Rocket. But fine. Let's win.

Archer & Giovanni.Archer: Boss! At last! Team Rocket's executive Archer, at your command!
Archer & Giovanni.Giovanni: Archer. You held the organization together. Now show me it was worth it.

Archer & Jasmine.Archer: Olivine's Gym Leader. Gentle souls make poor opponents, but adequate partners.
Archer & Jasmine.Jasmine: Um... Archer, please don't do anything bad while we battle, okay?

Archer & Karen.Archer: Karen of the Elite Four. Darkness suits us both, wouldn't you say?
Archer & Karen.Karen: Archer. We share an affinity for the night, not a cause. Remember that.

Archer & Koga.Archer: Koga, the poison ninja. Team Rocket could have used a man like you.
Archer & Koga.Koga: Fwahaha! A ninja serves no criminal, Archer. But today, we strike together!

Archer & Lance.Archer: The Dragon Master who ruined our Mahogany operation. The irony isn't lost on me.
Archer & Lance.Lance: Archer. I'll be watching you every turn of this battle.

Archer & Morty.Archer: Ecruteak's seer. Tell me, do you see Team Rocket's return?
Archer & Morty.Morty: Archer. I see this battle, and nothing beyond it for your team.

Archer & Petrel.Archer: Petrel. Drop the disguises today, please. I need you as yourself.
Archer & Petrel.Petrel: Archer! Which self do you want? I have several!

Archer & Proton.Archer: Proton. Save the cruelty for our opponent.
Archer & Proton.Proton: Archer. No promises. That's half the fun.

Archer & Pryce.Archer: Mahogany's old Gym Leader. We were practically neighbors.
Archer & Pryce.Pryce: Archer. Your hideout under my town was not neighborly. Let's just battle.

Archer & Whitney.Archer: Goldenrod's Gym Leader. No hard feelings about the Radio Tower, I trust.
Archer & Whitney.Whitney: Hard feelings? You took over our Radio Tower! ...Fine, let's just win!

Archer & Will.Archer: The masked psychic. Read my mind, and you'll find nothing but strategy.
Archer & Will.Will: Archer. Your mind is orderly. Unpleasantly so. Let us begin.

Ariana & Bruno.Ariana: Bruno. All that muscle, and still on the wrong side. Today it's my side.
Ariana & Bruno.Bruno: Hmph! I stand beside you only because the draw says so!

Ariana & Bugsy.Ariana: Bugsy. Stop glaring. We're on the same team for once.
Ariana & Bugsy.Bugsy: Ariana. I'll battle with you. I won't like it.

Ariana & Chuck.Chuck: WAHAHAH! A Rocket lady with attitude! Let's go!

Ariana & Clair.Ariana: Clair. You and I both know how to command a room. Let's command this one.
Ariana & Clair.Clair: Ariana. For once, I agree with a Rocket. Let's win.

Ariana & Falkner.Ariana: Falkner. Don't let your birds peck at my partners this time.
Ariana & Falkner.Falkner: Ariana. As long as you keep your hands to yourself, we'll be fine.

Ariana & Giovanni.Ariana: Boss. Team Rocket's executive Ariana, reporting. We waited for you.
Ariana & Giovanni.Giovanni: Ariana. Loyal as ever. Let's remind the world why they feared us.

Ariana & Jasmine.Ariana: Jasmine. Sweet girl. Try not to apologize to our opponent mid-battle.
Ariana & Jasmine.Jasmine: Ariana... I'll try. But you be nice too, okay?

Ariana & Karen.Ariana: Karen. A woman who doesn't care what others think. I respect that.
Ariana & Karen.Karen: Ariana. I care what my partners think. That's the difference between us.

Ariana & Koga.Ariana: Koga. A man of poison. We understand each other.
Ariana & Koga.Koga: Fwahaha! Ariana, our poisons are alike, but our hearts are not.

Ariana & Lance.Ariana: Lance. You sent half our grunts running in Mahogany. Impressive, I'll admit.
Ariana & Lance.Lance: Ariana. Behave yourself, and I won't have to do it again.

Ariana & Morty.Ariana: Morty. Stop staring at me like you can see my past.
Ariana & Morty.Morty: Ariana. I see a past. I also see a choice to make better ones.

Ariana & Petrel.Ariana: Petrel. If you impersonate me today, I'll end you.
Ariana & Petrel.Petrel: Ariana! I would never! ...Your outfit's too hard to copy anyway.

Ariana & Proton.Ariana: Proton. Cruel and useful. Let's go.
Ariana & Proton.Proton: Ariana. Glad someone appreciates my talents.

Ariana & Pryce.Ariana: Pryce. Old and cold. My kind of partner.
Ariana & Pryce.Pryce: Ariana. Cold, yes. On your side? Only today.

Ariana & Whitney.Ariana: Whitney. If you cry, I'm leaving.

Ariana & Will.Ariana: Will. Keep your mind games pointed at them, not me.
Ariana & Will.Will: Ariana. Your mind is guarded. Wise.

Proton & Bruno.Proton: Bruno. Big guy. Let's be cruel together.
Proton & Bruno.Bruno: Hmph! I am never cruel! Only strong! Hoo hah!

Proton & Bugsy.Proton: Bugsy! Long time since that business at the Azalea well. Still mad?
Proton & Bugsy.Bugsy: Proton. Yes. Very. Let's just battle before I say something I regret.

Proton & Chuck.Proton: Chuck. You punch things. I hurt things. Same idea.
Proton & Chuck.Chuck: WAHAH... no, not the same idea! But let's win anyway!

Proton & Clair.Proton: Clair. Your dragons look mean. I like mean.
Proton & Clair.Clair: Proton. My dragons are proud, not mean. You wouldn't know the difference.

Proton & Falkner.Proton: Falkner. Birds are fun to scare. Not yours, though. Today.
Proton & Falkner.Falkner: Proton. One wrong move toward my birds and we're done.

Proton & Giovanni.Proton: Boss! The scariest, cruelest guy in Team Rocket, ready to serve!
Proton & Giovanni.Giovanni: Proton. Cruelty is only useful when it wins. Win.

Proton & Jasmine.Proton: Jasmine. You look like you've never been mean in your life.
Proton & Jasmine.Jasmine: Proton... I haven't. And I won't start now.

Proton & Karen.Proton: Karen. Dark and cool. Let's scare them silly.
Proton & Karen.Karen: Proton. Strength isn't about scaring people. Watch and learn.

Proton & Koga.Proton: Koga. Poison buddies! Let's make them suffer.
